title: GovernanceReport
description: Tier G (governance) oversight verdict for one run, compiled once after every Tier 1 domain and the Tier 0.5 attack-scenario-analyst have reported in. Combines PolicyCop's EU regulatory/legislative compliance findings (engine/policy_checks.py), CostCop's token-budget status (engine/token_budget.py), and Ethica's non-exploitation/guardrail flags (engine/ethics_checks.py) into Warden's single verdict (engine/governance.py). This is never a judgement about a TARGET's risk -- that's what findings/issues already are -- it's a judgement about the FLEET'S OWN conduct and cost this run.

report_id.description: Deterministic fingerprint: sha256(run_id, generated_at). Computed by engine/governance.py, never asserted.

cost.description: CostCop's token-budget status -- real arithmetic over scope/token-usage-ledger.yaml, never an estimate.

measured.description: False when no live session has ever reported real usage via `engine.cli record-usage` -- CostCop never fabricates a spend number, and a never-measured run reports honestly as such rather than defaulting to 0.

alert.description: True once remaining_pct has dropped below alert_threshold_pct.

ethics.description: Ethica's non-exploitation/guardrail pass over this run's own findings, attack scenarios, and event log.

verdict.description: Warden's aggregate verdict: critical if any policy violation or ethics flag is severity=critical; warning if any is severity=warning or CostCop's cost.alert is true; clear otherwise.

kill_switch_engaged.description: True exactly when verdict=critical. The orchestrator responds by triggering this run's kill switch (a record, since governance runs after everything else this run does) AND writing a fleet-wide halt flag that refuses every future run until a human runs `engine.cli resume` -- see engine/governance.py.

escalation_reason.description: Human-readable summary of the violation(s)/flag(s)/cost-alert driving a non-clear verdict. Null when verdict=clear.
